name: lazyfinder-git-tab
criterio: order 07 point O, narrowed by Mathias on 2026-10-14 ("no quiero hacer commit en un sidebar … solo ver que es lo que cambio"): the Git tab lists staged and unstaged changes and shows the diff; it stages, discards, stashes, switches branch and pushes nothing
cmd: cd "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj" && export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null && g() { git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false "$@"; } && g init -q -b trunk . && g add . && g commit -q -m init && g branch side && echo changed >> notes.txt && echo x > loose.txt; exec "${LAZYFINDER_BIN}" --sidebar "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj"

steps.desc: the Git tab is one click away
the selected row wears one button, the diff
no discard and no stage button
a row nobody points at shows its letter instead
the pointer on the second row shows its buttons and a soft background
the keys that used to stage, discard, stash, switch branch, pull and push do nothing
Enter still shows what changed, so nothing was stashed or discarded
the branch is the same and both files are still listed
